caption: RECIPE BELOW👇 These secret veggie packed donuts are a hit with my whole family, and taste amazing with only about 7 grams of added sugar per serving! Save this the next time you’re craving donuts and share with a friend who needs to try this! Follow for daily healthy recipes that taste just like your favorite treats! Ingredients:  1 banana 1/2 cup carrots 1/2 cup spinach 1 egg 1/4 cup maple syrup 2 tbsp melted coconut oil 1/4 tsp salt 1/2 tsp vanilla 1/4 cup cocoa powder + 1 tbsp 1 cup flour 1.5 tsp baking powder optional: 2 tbsp dairy free dark chocolate chips + 1 tsp melted coconut oil  Add banana, carrots, spinach, egg, maple syrup, 2 tbsp coconut oil, salt, and vanilla to a blender and blend until smooth Add the cocoa powder, flour and baking powder to a mixing bowl and mix until combined.  Add the blender batter to the mixing bowl with the flour and mix until just combined. Grease a donut pan with cooking spray (I like avocado oil cooking spray for this) Add your donut batter to the pan Bake 18-20 min at 350 degrees F  Melt dark chocolate chips + coconut oil in the microwave Drizzle over donuts Top with sprinkles Enjoy! #donuts #doughnut
